description: Move a page item so its top-left corner (geometric bounds) is at x, y mm on the page

itemIndex.description: Index of the page item to move, in page.allPageItems as numbered by list_page_items (nested items included)

pageIndex.description: Index of the page containing the item (0-based)

x.description: New X of the item's top-left corner, in mm from the page left edge

y.description: New Y of the item's top-left corner, in mm from the page top edge

name: move_page_item
title: Move Page Item
